article_manifest.title: Mali: at least eight women and children killed by army shelling in the Ségou region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: au moins huit femmes et enfants tués par des bombardements de l'armée dans la région de Ségou
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, at least eight people, mostly women and children, were killed on Monday, October 12, 2026 in aerial bombardments in Zanakoro, a Fulani village in the Ségou region. The Malian army, which is fighting in this part of the country the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, did not communicate on these strikes . Published on: On the images broadcast by the villagers, burnt babies lose their skin by shreds.

article_manifest.title: Reversal of alliances
article_manifest.original_title: Renversement d’alliances
article_manifest.summary: The recent bombing of Riyadh International Airport by Yemeni Houthi forces with a dozen dead at the door reflects an implacable truth that the President of Faso, Captain Ibrahim Traoré, has constantly affirmed, namely that "the weak will disappear" .

article_manifest.title: Niger criticizes a "serious and unacceptable act of ingratitude" after the expulsion of two agents by France
article_manifest.original_title: Le Niger fustige un «acte d’ingratitude grave et inacceptable» après l’expulsion de deux agents par la France
article_manifest.summary: The two agents were "security officers" at the embassy, one of them had been wounded during a Franco-Nigerian military operation and evacuated to France to be treated .

article_manifest.title: Tebboune receives the Minister of Defense of Niger and discusses enhancing security and military cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: تبون يستقبل وزير دفاع النيجر ويبحث تعزيز التعاون الأمني والعسكري
article_manifest.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Minister of Defense in Niger, received General Salifou Modi and his accompanying delegation, according to a statement by the Algerian presidency. The meeting was attended by the Chief of Staff of the Algerian Army, General Said Changiha, Interior Minister Ibrahim Murad, and Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf.

article_manifest.title: National Youth Service: The 7th cohort officially presented to the flag by General Assimi GOÏTA
article_manifest.original_title: Service National des Jeunes : La 7ᵉ cohorte officiellement présentée au drapeau par le Général Assimi GOÏTA
article_manifest.summary: NATIONAL YOUTH SERVICE: 2,400 recruits presented to the flag The President of the Transition, Head of State and Supreme Head of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi GOÏTA, presided, this Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at the place d 'armes of the 34th Military Engineer Regiment of Bamako, the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 7th cohort of the National Youth Service (SNJ) .

article_manifest.title: FAMa: Goïta confirms the recruitment of 2,400 soldiers, including 800 women
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : GoÏta confirme le recrutement de 2400 soldats dont 800 femmes
article_manifest.summary: Mali continues to strengthen its defence and security forces, relying on young people to strengthen its ranks. This Tuesday, October 13, Army General Assimi Goïta, President of the Transition, Head of State and Supreme Head of the Armed Forces, chaired in Bamako the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 7th cohort of the National Youth Service (SNJ) . On the place d 'armes of the 34th Regiment of Military Engineers, it welcomed 2,400 recruits, including 800 women, who are now joining the reserve of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).

article_manifest.title: NATIONAL YOUTH SERVICE: 2,400 recruits presented to the flag
article_manifest.original_title: SERVICE NATIONAL DES JEUNES : 2 400 recrues présentées au drapeau
article_manifest.summary: The President of the Transition, Head of State and Supreme Head of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi GOÏTA, presided, this Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at the place d 'armes of the 34th Military Engineer Regiment of Bamako, the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 7th cohort of the National Youth Service (SNJ) . Composed of 2,400 recruits, including 800 women, this promotion has completed six months of military and civic training and now joins the strategic reserve of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).

article_manifest.title: Axis Ségou-Bamako: an accident involving three vehicles killed and injured
article_manifest.original_title: Axe Ségou-Bamako : un accident impliquant trois véhicules fait des morts et des blessés
article_manifest.summary: Ségou-Bamako axis: an accident involving three vehicles killed and injured A serious traffic accident involving three vehicles occurred on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 on the Ségou-Bamako axis, between Sébougou and the village of Sékoro. The collision involved a trailer truck, a UNICEF vehicle and a Jeep . According to initial information reported by Sudan Infos, the UNICEF trailer truck and vehicle were heading towards Bamako, while the Jeep was driving towards Ségou.

article_manifest.title: Trump threatens the Houthis: “I'll be there after the election, and I'll never forget”
article_manifest.original_title: Trump menace les Houthis : « Je serai là après les élections, et je n'oublierai jamais »
article_manifest.summary: Trump threatens the Houthis: “I will be there after the elections, and I will never forget” The Houthis' strikes against Saudi Arabia earned the Yemeni movement a public warning from Donald Trump on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. “The Houthis are behaving very badly. I thought they had learned the lesson a year ago when we bombed them TO DEATH and, at their request, we stopped,” the US president said.

article_manifest.title: Sudan: Investigation into a strike that reportedly killed 72 gold miners
article_manifest.original_title: Soudan : enquête sur une frappe qui aurait tué 72 mineurs d’or
article_manifest.summary: Sudan: investigation into a strike that allegedly killed 72 gold miners The toll put forward by Emergency Lawyers and the origin of the strike have not been independently confirmed. Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan on Monday ordered the establishment of a commission of inquiry after a reported strike in the Jabal al-Uqaydat mining area near the border with Egypt .

article_manifest.title: THE TITLES OF 13 OCTOBER 2026
article_manifest.original_title: LES TITRES DU 13 OCTOBRE 2026
article_manifest.summary: - The trial of Adama Sangaré, former mayor of the district of Bamako, and his co-defendants opened yesterday before the National Economic and Financial Center. They are being prosecuted in the case of the fragmentation of the Bamako-Sénou airport area. - In Kourémalé, near the Guinean border, the death of a young man during a police check provoked the anger of the inhabitants Protesters attacked the police station and blocked the national road.

article_manifest.title: Ivory Coast-Mali: the boss of Ivorian intelligence expected in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Côte d’Ivoire-Mali : le patron des renseignements ivoiriens attendu à Bamako
article_manifest.summary: Côte d 'Ivoire-Mali: the head of Ivorian intelligence expected in Bamako Faced with the progression of the jihadist threat in the south of its territory and the strategic challenges of the Abidjan-Bamako corridor, Mali shows its willingness to relaunch intelligence cooperation with its neighbor, after several years of tensions . Is security cooperation officially resuming between Abidjan and Bamako?

article_manifest.title: Army General Said Chanegriha receives the Minister of State, Minister of National Defence of Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Le Général d’Armée Saïd Chanegriha reçoit le ministre d’Etat, ministre de la Défense nationale du Niger
article_manifest.summary: The Minister Delegate to the Minister of National Defence, Chief of Staff of the People's National Army (ANP), Army General Said Chanegriha, received Tuesday, at the headquarters of the ANP General Staff, the Minister of State, Minister of National Defence of the Republic of Niger, brotherly country, Army General Salifou Modi, indicates a statement from the Department of National Defence (DND).

article_manifest.title: Mali: Protesters denounce a police "blunder" after the death of a young man in Kourémalé
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: des manifestants dénoncent une «bavure» policière après la mort d'un jeune homme à Kourémalé
article_manifest.summary: The victim is a young man in his thirties, employed as a guard on a gold panning site. Sunday evening, October 11, as he leaves for his motorcycle service, carrying a passenger with him, police officers try to control him. Some sources mention a vignette affair.

article_manifest.title: AGADEZ: The Governor chairs an enlarged meeting of the Regional Security Council
article_manifest.original_title: AGADEZ : Le Gouverneur préside une réunion élargie du Conseil Régional de Sécurité
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Oct. 13 (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired a meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) in the Governorate's meeting room on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. The meeting of the Regional Security Council was extended to several directorates, including the Regional Directorate of Trade, the SONIDEP Depot Directorate, and the Regional Directorate of Petroleum .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Nduhungirehe, Mali Foreign Minister Discuss Ties, Regional Security
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Nduhungirehe, Mali Foreign Minister Discuss Ties, Regional Security
article_manifest.summary: The Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Olivier Nduhungirehe on Monday, October 12, held talks with his Malian counterpart Abdoulaye Diop in Bamako. ALSO READ: Rwanda, Mali to foster military cooperation Nduhungirehe and Diop discussed regional security and the two countries' bilateral relations and prospects for expanding cooperation in areas of common interest.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Protesters denounce a police "blunder" after the death of a young man in Kourémalé
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Des manifestants dénoncent une «bavure» policière après la mort d'un jeune homme à Kourémalé
article_manifest.summary: Protest movements turned into a riot on Monday, October 12, in Kourémalé, a town on the border with Guinea, after the death, Sunday evening, of a young man during a police check gone wrong. Protesters protested against a new “blunder”, according to them, by the police, after a similar incident last week . The victim is a young man in his thirties, employed as a guard on a gold mining site.

article_manifest.title: Tessit: violent clashes between ISIS in the Sahel and JNIM
article_manifest.original_title: Tessit : violents affrontements entre l’EI au Sahel et le JNIM
article_manifest.summary: Tessit: violent clashes between ISIL in the Sahel and JNIM Violent clashes took place on 9 October 2026 between the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS) and the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (JNIM) in the Three Borders area, near Tessit. According to reports, the fighting caused many casualties and resulted in territorial losses for one of the groups . Both organizations were also reported to have mobilized reinforcements during the clashes.

article_manifest.title: Niger Wrestles with the Aftermath of a Military Revolt
article_manifest.original_title: Niger Wrestles with the Aftermath of a Military Revolt
article_manifest.summary: A mutiny by Niger’s special forces in late August morphed into a coup attempt. In this Q&A, Crisis Group experts explain how the unrest exposed growing discontent within the military’s ranks.
